summary: Learn to build results chains, test assumptions, and plan indicators. Explore this five-day M&E course and strengthen programme monitoring.
lede: Logic model development for monitoring and evaluation connects programme activities to intended outcomes through clear causal pathways. For programme designers, M&E officers, and project managers, this involves testing assumptions, drafting outcome indicators and reference sheets, and mapping data sources into a practical measurement plan. The work also considers data quality constraints and how monitoring evidence can inform programme review and adaptation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape programme logic, monitor implementation, or use evaluation evidence to guide development work.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with programme objectives and activities is useful. No programming is required.
